the-contract-and-its-binding.text: This page reports conformance evidence for the generic registry that cardano-keri consumes, bound to a pinned cardano-keri commit. cardano-keri needs Insert, Update and Delete; the naming demonstration refuses Delete by design, so no naming run can evidence these rows.

the-denominator.text: The inventory file carries forty-one rows with forty owned. Row CK zero six — bonds, poison, the juvenility window and the signature threshold — is recorded as out of scope: it belongs to cardano-keri's checkpoint machine, and is never claimed here.
The word executed never appears in the inventory file itself; a row prints as executed only when a run receipt for it exists and matches the current commit.

what-this-slice-executes.text: One cage, one key, four rows in order. Update folds and the new value reads back from the chain. Delete folds and the key proves absent. Re-insert folds and the third value reads back. Insert on the occupied key is refused by the state script, and a fresh cage accepting a valid insert proves the refusal discriminates.
Every accepting row carries a deliberately wrong variant the run requires to fail, and every refusal is attributed to the script that produced it.

measurements.text: Ship run on a clean tree with cardano-node ten point seven. Execution units use under three percent of the devnet maxima, which are queried from the running node, never hardcoded.
Serialized size is the tight dimension at about seventy percent of the transaction maximum; the worst case across the three accepting folds is recorded in the CL zero one receipt.

what-this-slice-does-not-establish.text: Five rows rest on predecessor runs and are cited, not re-executed. Everything else prints uncovered, including four expected consumer gaps that are recorded to observe, not passed.
Checkpoint policy, naming rows and recovery rows belong to other owners. Single-request devnet folds say nothing about batch limits or other environments.

commands.text: List prints the inventory. Run executes the four rows with measurements, controls and receipts under the run's own output directory. List against those receipts shows what executed.
Two armed controls — an impossible refusal marker and forged claim values — must each fail the run with a non-zero exit.

observed-environment.text: Observed with cardano-node ten point seven, GHC nine point twelve point three, and the Aiken compiler pinned by the blueprint, with both script hashes recorded. Any other environment is explicitly not covered.
